selector.rationale: Psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis on skin biopsy and clinical presentation of polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale

rejected.label: Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris
rejected.why: Lower score and less specific evidence

rejected.label: Alopecia
rejected.why: Although sparse eyebrow hairs and brittle scalp hairs are noted, the primary presentation and biopsy results more strongly support Psoriasis
